attack_patterns: Use of deceptive HTML forms to harvest credentials
Multi-stage URL redirects to mask final malicious destination
Embedding social engineering text content within webpages
Obfuscation of scripts and DOM manipulation to evade detection
attack_sophistication_levels: Intermediate with redirect chains and script obfuscation
Advanced dynamic content injection and multi-modal evasion
mitigation_strategies: Multi-modal machine learning detection combining URL, HTML, and text features
detection_approaches: Pattern deviation detection from normal HTML and URL baselines
Multi-modal feature extraction from HTML content and URL structures
Anomaly detection on redirect chains and embedded scripts
Natural language processing to identify social engineering text
